tools.name: get_discounted_items
tools.description: Get currently discounted items (cenové trháky / sales). Returns products on sale, optionally filtered by sale type and food category. Without a category, returns deals across all categories. Call with list_categories=true to see available category IDs. Recommended to use sale_type 'sales' and 'premium-sales' as default for best deals overview.

sale_type.description: Type of sale/discount section. 'sales' = all deals (default), 'week-sales' = weekly deals (Akce týdne), 'multipack' = buy more pay less (Kup víc zaplať míň), 'bundles' = product bundles (Produktové balíčky), 'premium-sales' = exclusive deals for paid Xtra subscribers only (Exkluzivně pro Xtra), 'favorite-sales' = popular deals (Oblíbené v akci). Recommended: use 'sales' and 'premium-sales' for best overview.

category_id.description: Food category ID to filter by. Use list_categories=true first to see available categories and their IDs. If omitted, returns discounted items across all categories.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (1-50, default: 14)

list_categories.description: If true, returns the list of available sales categories instead of products
